description: This file contains a function 'display_condition_lines' responsible for generating HTML and JavaScript code to display and manage condition lines in the SuiteCRM workflow module. It handles both 'EditView' and 'DetailView' modes, including loading related JavaScript files, querying the database for conditions, and dynamically injecting scripting to load condition data.

methods.name: display_condition_lines
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript to display condition lines on Workflow condition editing/detail pages, supports loading existing conditions, dynamically includes scripts, and manages related modules information.
